title: ALMS Machine Speed Jay
subject: Machine Speed Jay
purpose: Define a bounded acceleration lane for ALMS work inside the AL repository while preserving replay, receipt, and no-fake-green invariants.

core_signal.name: ALMS Machine Speed Jay
core_signal.intent: Increase execution speed without sacrificing verification boundaries.

speed_rules.SR_001: Acceleration MAY reduce handoff friction but SHALL NOT bypass verification.
speed_rules.SR_002: Machine-generated outputs SHALL remain procedural until independently reviewed or replayed.
speed_rules.SR_003: No receipt SHALL be treated as proof of external truth or authority.
speed_rules.SR_004: Fast lanes SHALL preserve input, output, timestamp, and dependency visibility.
speed_rules.SR_005: Blocked states SHALL remain visible rather than converted into fake success.

blocked_actions: claiming external truth from process receipts
granting authority from speed lane output
summary: ALMS Machine Speed Jay establishes a bounded acceleration lane: faster execution is allowed only when replay, receipts, human-review boundaries, and no-fake-green invariants remain intact.
